product_name: MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day L3 Global 1km (MOD11A2)
licence_note: NASA EOSDIS data are generally available for research and education; verify current LP DAAC/NASA data-use policy before redistribution.
native_units: Kelvin (scaled in HDF; this teaching extract stores Kelvin already)
crs: EPSG:4326 (teaching extract tabular points; native product is sinusoidal grid)
access_method: LP DAAC / Earthdata Search (account may be required for bulk download)
teaching_extract_disclaimer: CSV values are a small offline teaching extract matching the schema and unit conventions of MOD11A2 LST_Day for CI. They are NOT a verified Multan download and MUST NOT be cited as observed Multan LST.
distinctions: LST is land-surface temperature, not near-surface air temperature
Daytime 8-day composites are not hourly heatwave meteorology
Point/neighbourhood means require documented aggregation from native grid
